```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cmdstanr)
library(here)
library(patchwork)

fits <- readRDS(here("outputs", "fits.rds"))
df_contrasts <- readRDS(here("outputs", "df_contrasts.rds"))
```

# Summary
```{r}
summarise_fit <- function(fit, spec_name, draws = FALSE) {
  vars <- c("mu_d", "tau", "Omega", "sigma_within", "sigma_ppt",
            "d_total_vs_L1", "d_conceptual_vs_L1", "d_conceptual_vs_total")
  
  # add beta only if the model had moderators
  if (any(grepl("^beta", fit$metadata()$stan_variables)))
    vars <- c(vars, "beta")
  
  if (draws) {
    fit$draws(vars) |> 
      as_tibble() |> 
      mutate(model = spec_name, .before = 1)
  } else {
    fit$summary(
      vars,
      mean, median, sd, mad,
      \(x) posterior::quantile2(x, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)),
      posterior::default_convergence_measures()
    ) |>
      mutate(model = spec_name, .before = 1)
  }
}
```

```{r}
df_res_all <- imap(fits, summarise_fit) |> bind_rows()
write_csv(df_res_all, here("outputs", "df_res_all.csv"))
```

```{r eval=F}
df_draws <- imap(fits, \(f, n) summarise_fit(f, n, draws = TRUE)) |> bind_rows()
```

```{r}
arm_lab <- c(`2` = "single-language", `3` = "total", `4` = "conceptual")
covar_lab <- c(
  `1` = "Age",
  `2` = "Vocab domain",
  `3` = "Typical devt",
  `4` = "Inst type",
  `5` = "ASJP dist"
)

p_res <- df_res_all |>
  filter(model %in% c("base", "full")) |>
  separate_wider_delim(variable, delim = "[", too_few = "align_start",
                       names = c("variable", "comparison")) |>
  filter(variable != "Omega",
         !str_starts(variable, "d_"),
         variable != "beta") |>
  mutate(comparison = str_remove_all(comparison, "(,1)?]") |>
           factor(levels = c(1, 2, 3),
                  labels = c("single-language", "total", "conceptual")),
         model = factor(model, levels = c("base", "full"),
                        labels = c("Base", "Full")),
         variable = factor(variable,
                           levels = c("mu_d", "sigma_within", "sigma_ppt", "tau"),
                           labels = c("Effect size", "Within corr var",
                                      "Between var", "Heterogeneity")) |>
           fct_rev(),
         credible = if_else(sign(q2.5) == sign(q97.5), "credible", "not credible")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mean, y = variable, col = comparison, group = comparison)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, lty = "dashed") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = q2.5, xmax = q97.5), height = 0,
                position = position_dodge(0.5)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = credible),
                position = position_dodge(0.5)) +
  facet_grid(~ model) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.box = "vertical",
        legend.spacing = unit(0, "pt")) +
  labs(x = "Posterior estimate", y = "", col = "Vocab measure", shape = "Credibility")

p_res
```

# Moderator plots
Lines and bands are from the **full** model at the grand mean (other covariates held at 0 under ±0.5 / centred coding). Points are complete-case rows. Categorical predictors dodge by vocab measure so the mean+CI sits on that measure’s points. The strip above each panel is a histogram of bilingual–bilingual contrasts at those \(x\)-values. Main panels are monolingual vs bilingual; bilingual vs bilingual are plotted separately.

```{r}
full_f <- ~ age_c + vocab_c + typical_c + proc_c + asjp_c
full_raw <- c("age_c", "vocab_type", "infant_typical", "assessment_procedure", "asjp_dist")

moderator_specs <- list(
  age                  = list(x = "age_c",                xlab = "Age (years)",         title = "Age"),
  vocab_type           = list(x = "vocab_type",           xlab = "Vocab domain",         title = "Vocab domain"),
  infant_typical       = list(x = "infant_typical",       xlab = "Typical development",  title = "Typical development"),
  assessment_procedure = list(x = "assessment_procedure", xlab = "Assessment type",      title = "Assessment type"),
  asjp_dist            = list(x = "asjp_dist",            xlab = "ASJP distance",        title = "ASJP distance")
)

make_grid <- function(df, xvar) {
  asjp_center <- mean(df$asjp_dist)
  if (is.numeric(df[[xvar]])) {
    xs <- seq(min(df[[xvar]]), max(df[[xvar]]), length.out = 80)
    grid <- tibble(age_c = 0, vocab_c = 0, typical_c = 0, proc_c = 0, asjp_c = 0)[rep(1, 80), ]
    if (xvar == "age_c") grid$age_c <- xs
    if (xvar == "asjp_dist") grid$asjp_c <- xs - asjp_center
  } else {
    xs <- sort(unique(df[[xvar]]))
    grid <- tibble(age_c = 0, vocab_c = 0, typical_c = 0, proc_c = 0, asjp_c = 0)[rep(1, length(xs)), ]
    if (xvar == "vocab_type")
      grid$vocab_c <- if_else(as.character(xs) == "expressive", 0.5, -0.5)
    if (xvar == "infant_typical")
      grid$typical_c <- if_else(xs, 0.5, -0.5)
    if (xvar == "assessment_procedure")
      grid$proc_c <- if_else(as.character(xs) == "direct", 0.5, -0.5)
  }
  grid[[xvar]] <- xs
  grid
}

pairs_mono <- list(
  list(trt = 2L, ref = 1L),
  list(trt = 3L, ref = 1L),
  list(trt = 4L, ref = 1L)
)
pairs_bi <- list(
  list(trt = 3L, ref = 2L),
  list(trt = 4L, ref = 2L),
  list(trt = 4L, ref = 3L)
)

pair_lab <- function(trt, ref) {
  if (ref == 1L) unname(arm_lab[as.character(trt)])
  else paste0(arm_lab[as.character(trt)], " vs ", arm_lab[as.character(ref)])
}

model_band <- function(fit, formula, grid, pairs) {
  X <- model.matrix(formula, grid)
  X <- X[, setdiff(colnames(X), "(Intercept)"), drop = FALSE]
  mu   <- as.matrix(fit$draws("mu_d", format = "draws_matrix"))
  beta <- as.matrix(fit$draws("beta", format = "draws_matrix"))
  P <- ncol(X)
  map(pairs, function(pr) {
    k_trt <- pr$trt - 1L
    k_ref <- pr$ref - 1L
    mu_eta <- if (k_trt > 0) mu[, k_trt] else 0
    if (k_ref > 0) mu_eta <- mu_eta - mu[, k_ref]
    b <- matrix(0, nrow(mu), P)
    if (k_trt > 0) b <- b + beta[, paste0("beta[", k_trt, ",", seq_len(P), "]"), drop = FALSE]
    if (k_ref > 0) b <- b - beta[, paste0("beta[", k_ref, ",", seq_len(P), "]"), drop = FALSE]
    eta <- sweep(b %*% t(X), 1, mu_eta, "+")
    grid |>
      mutate(
        comparison = pair_lab(pr$trt, pr$ref),
        mean = colMeans(eta),
        q2.5 = apply(eta, 2, quantile, 0.025),
        q97.5 = apply(eta, 2, quantile, 0.975)
      )
  }) |> list_rbind()
}

plot_moderator <- function(spec, pairs, title) {
  xvar <- spec$x
  df_fit <- df_contrasts |> drop_na(all_of(full_raw))
  grid <- make_grid(df_fit, xvar)
  band <- model_band(fits$full, full_f, grid, pairs)
  keys <- map_chr(pairs, \(p) paste(p$trt, p$ref))
  comps <- unique(map_chr(pairs, \(p) pair_lab(p$trt, p$ref)))
  pts <- df_fit |>
    filter(paste(arm_trt, arm_ref) %in% keys) |>
    mutate(
      comparison = factor(map2_chr(arm_trt, arm_ref, pair_lab), levels = comps),
      oob = case_when(y > 8 ~ "hi", y < -8 ~ "lo", .default = "in"),
      y_plot = pmin(pmax(y, -8), 8)
    )
  band <- band |> mutate(comparison = factor(comparison, levels = comps))

  pretty_x <- function(d) {
    if (xvar == "infant_typical")
      d[[xvar]] <- factor(d[[xvar]], levels = c(FALSE, TRUE),
                          labels = c("atypical", "typical"))
    d
  }
  band <- pretty_x(band)
  pts  <- pretty_x(pts)

  if (xvar == "age_c") {
    grand_age <- mean(df_fit$age_trt - 12 * df_fit$age_c, na.rm = TRUE)
    pts  <- pts  |> mutate(x_plot = age_trt / 12)
    band <- band |> mutate(x_plot = age_c + grand_age / 12)
  } else {
    pts  <- pts  |> mutate(x_plot = .data[[xvar]])
    band <- band |> mutate(x_plot = .data[[xvar]])
  }

  bi_keys <- map_chr(pairs_bi, \(p) paste(p$trt, p$ref))
  hist_df <- df_fit |>
    filter(paste(arm_trt, arm_ref) %in% bi_keys) |>
    pretty_x()
  if (xvar == "age_c") {
    hist_df <- hist_df |> mutate(x_plot = age_trt / 12)
  } else {
    hist_df <- hist_df |> mutate(x_plot = .data[[xvar]])
  }

  is_cat <- !is.numeric(pts$x_plot)
  p <- ggplot() + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty = "dashed")

  if (is_cat) {
    x_lvls <- if (is.factor(pts$x_plot)) levels(pts$x_plot) else sort(unique(as.character(pts$x_plot)))
    pts     <- pts     |> mutate(x_plot = factor(x_plot, levels = x_lvls))
    band    <- band    |> mutate(x_plot = factor(x_plot, levels = x_lvls))
    hist_df <- hist_df |> mutate(x_plot = factor(as.character(x_plot), levels = x_lvls))
    n_comp <- nlevels(pts$comparison)
    dw <- 0.6
    dodge_off <- \(g) (as.integer(g) - (n_comp + 1) / 2) * (dw / n_comp)
    pts  <- pts  |> mutate(x_num = as.numeric(x_plot) + dodge_off(comparison) +
                             runif(n(), -0.06, 0.06))
    band <- band |> mutate(x_num = as.numeric(x_plot) + dodge_off(comparison))
    p <- p +
      geom_point(aes(x_num, y_plot, color = comparison, fill = comparison, shape = oob),
                 data = pts, alpha = 0.15) +
      geom_pointrange(aes(x_num, y = mean, ymin = q2.5, ymax = q97.5, color = comparison),
                      data = band) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(x_lvls), labels = x_lvls, expand = c(0, 0)) +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-8, 8), xlim = c(0.4, length(x_lvls) + 0.6))
    p_hist <- ggplot(hist_df, aes(as.numeric(x_plot))) +
      geom_bar(fill = "grey55", width = 0.2) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(x_lvls), expand = c(0, 0)) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.4, length(x_lvls) + 0.6))
  } else {
    p <- p +
      geom_point(aes(x_plot, y_plot, color = comparison, fill = comparison, shape = oob),
                 data = pts, alpha = 0.15) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(x_plot, ymin = q2.5, ymax = q97.5, fill = comparison, group = comparison),
                  data = band, alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
      geom_line(aes(x_plot, mean, color = comparison, group = comparison), data = band)
    x_rng <- range(c(pts$x_plot, band$x_plot, hist_df$x_plot), na.rm = TRUE)
    p_hist <- ggplot(hist_df, aes(x_plot)) +
      geom_histogram(fill = "grey55", bins = 20, color = NA) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = x_rng)
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-8, 8), xlim = x_rng)
  }

  p <- p +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(`in` = 16, hi = 24, lo = 25), guide = "none") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom") +
    labs(x = spec$xlab, y = "Hedges' g",
         color = NULL, fill = NULL, title = title)

  p_hist <- p_hist +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 0, 5.5)) +
    labs(y = "N", title = NULL)

  p_hist / p + plot_layout(heights = c(0.22, 1), axes = "collect_x")
}
```

# Network plots
Edges are the same quantities as the forest plot: \(\mu_d\) for mono vs each bilingual arm, and \(\mu_d[k]-\mu_d[j]\) for bilingual vs bilingual (grand mean, \(X=0\)). Width is \(|\text{posterior median}|\); dashed if the 95% interval includes 0.

```{r}
plot_network <- function(fit, title) {
  mu <- as.matrix(fit$draws("mu_d", format = "draws_matrix"))
  abs_d <- cbind(0, mu)
  nodes <- tibble(
    arm = 1:4,
    name = c("Mono", "Bi-LS", "Bi-TV", "Bi-CV"),
    x = c(0, 1, 0, 1),
    y = c(1, 1, 0, 0)
  )
  edges <- list(c(1L, 2L), c(1L, 3L), c(1L, 4L), c(2L, 3L), c(2L, 4L), c(3L, 4L)) |>
    map(\(pr) {
      d <- abs_d[, pr[2]] - abs_d[, pr[1]]
      tibble(
        from = pr[1], to = pr[2],
        median = median(d),
        q2.5 = unname(quantile(d, 0.025)),
        q97.5 = unname(quantile(d, 0.975))
      )
    }) |> list_rbind() |>
    left_join(nodes |> select(from = arm, x1 = x, y1 = y), by = "from") |>
    left_join(nodes |> select(to = arm, x2 = x, y2 = y), by = "to") |>
    mutate(
      crosses0 = sign(q2.5) != sign(q97.5),
      lab = sprintf("%.2f", abs(median)),
      xm = (x1 + x2) / 2 + case_when(from == 1 & to == 4 ~ -0.12, from == 2 & to == 3 ~ -0.12, .default = 0),
      ym = (y1 + y2) / 2 + case_when(from == 1 & to == 4 ~  0.12, from == 2 & to == 3 ~ -0.12, .default = 0)
    )

  ggplot() +
    geom_segment(aes(x = x1, y = y1, xend = x2, yend = y2,
                     linewidth = abs(median), linetype = crosses0),
                 data = edges, color = "grey30") +
    geom_label(aes(xm, ym, label = lab), data = edges, size = 3, label.size = 0) +
    geom_point(aes(x, y), data = nodes, size = 12, color = "white") +
    geom_point(aes(x, y), data = nodes, size = 12, shape = 1, color = "grey20") +
    geom_text(aes(x, y, label = name), data = nodes, size = 3.2) +
    scale_linewidth(range = c(0.4, 4), guide = "none") +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "solid", `TRUE` = "dashed"), guide = "none") +
    coord_equal(xlim = c(-0.35, 1.35), ylim = c(-0.35, 1.35)) +
    theme_void() +
    labs(title = title)
}

plot_network(fits$base, "Base model")
plot_network(fits$full, "Full model")
```

# Results reporting

Outcome `y` is Hedges *g*, so $SD_y = 1$ and the RQ1 ROPE $[-0.1\,SD_y,\,0.1\,SD_y]$ is $[-0.1,\,0.1]$. Covariate ROPE is also $[-0.1,\,0.1]$. Age (years) and ASJP are mean-centred; binaries use $(-0.5,+0.5)$, so $\mu_d$ is a grand mean (comparable to the base model) and each $\beta$ is still the full group difference.

```{r}
hdi95 <- function(x) {
  x <- sort(as.numeric(x))
  n <- length(x)
  k <- max(1L, floor(0.95 * n))
  w <- x[k:n] - x[seq_len(n - k + 1)]
  i <- which.min(w)
  c(x[i], x[i + k - 1])
}

summarise_draws <- function(x, rope = c(-0.1, 0.1), rule = c("in", "out")) {
  rule <- match.arg(rule)
  h <- hdi95(x)
  p_in <- mean(x >= rope[1] & x <= rope[2])
  tibble(
    median = median(x),
    hdi_lo = h[1],
    hdi_hi = h[2],
    p_in_rope = p_in,
    p_out_rope = 1 - p_in,
    decision = if (rule == "in") {
      if (p_in > 0.95) "practically equivalent to 0" else "not equivalent to 0"
    } else {
      if (1 - p_in > 0.95) "significant (outside ROPE)" else "not significant"
    }
  )
}

comp_lab <- c(
  `1` = "mono vs single-language",
  `2` = "mono vs total",
  `3` = "mono vs conceptual"
)

pool_dl <- function(y, se) {
  ok <- is.finite(y) & is.finite(se) & se > 0
  y <- y[ok]; se <- se[ok]
  if (length(y) == 0) return(tibble(est = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, n = 0))
  w <- 1 / se^2
  fe <- sum(w * y) / sum(w)
  Q <- sum(w * (y - fe)^2)
  k <- length(y)
  den <- sum(w) - sum(w^2) / sum(w)
  tau2 <- if (k > 1 && den > 0) max(0, (Q - (k - 1)) / den) else 0
  wr <- 1 / (se^2 + tau2)
  tibble(est = sum(wr * y) / sum(wr), se = sqrt(1 / sum(wr)), n = k)
}

node_split_one <- function(name, dir_trt, dir_ref, path) {
  d <- df_contrasts |> filter(arm_trt == dir_trt, arm_ref == dir_ref)
  pd <- pool_dl(d$y, d$se_y)
  parts <- map(path, \(pr) {
    dat <- df_contrasts |> filter(arm_trt == pr[1], arm_ref == pr[2])
    pool_dl(dat$y * pr[3], dat$se_y)
  })
  ind <- sum(map_dbl(parts, "est"))
  ind_se <- sqrt(sum(map_dbl(parts, "se")^2))
  inc <- pd$est - ind
  inc_se <- sqrt(pd$se^2 + ind_se^2)
  z <- inc / inc_se
  tibble(
    comparison = name,
    n_direct = pd$n,
    n_indirect = sum(map_int(parts, "n")),
    direct = pd$est,
    indirect = ind,
    inconsistency = inc,
    se = inc_se,
    z = z,
    p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(z))
  )
}
```

```{r}
cat("Priors (weakly informative): mu_d ~ N(0,1); beta ~ N(0,0.5); tau, sigma_within, sigma_ppt ~ N+(0,0.3); L_Omega ~ LKJ(2)\n")
cat("MCMC: 4 chains, 1000 warmup, 2000 sampling, adapt_delta = 0.95\n\n")

conv <- imap(fits, \(fit, nm) {
  vars <- c("mu_d", "tau", "sigma_within", "sigma_ppt")
  if (any(grepl("^beta", fit$metadata()$stan_variables))) vars <- c(vars, "beta")
  s <- fit$summary(vars, "rhat", "ess_bulk")
  d <- fit$diagnostic_summary()
  tibble(
    model = nm,
    max_Rhat = max(s$rhat, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ess = min(s$ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE),
    divergences = sum(d$num_divergent)
  )
}) |> list_rbind()

cat("Convergence (Brooks–Gelman–Rubin R-hat; all < 1.01 is the usual threshold)\n")
print(conv, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
# RQ1: base model, three mono vs bi comparisons
mu <- as.matrix(fits$base$draws("mu_d", format = "draws_matrix"))
tau <- as.matrix(fits$base$draws("tau", format = "draws_matrix"))
s2 <- df_contrasts |>
  filter(arm_ref == 1) |>
  group_by(k = arm_trt - 1) |>
  summarise(s2 = median(se_y^2), .groups = "drop")

rq1 <- map(1:3, \(k) {
  summarise_draws(mu[, k], rule = "in") |>
    mutate(comparison = comp_lab[as.character(k)], .before = 1)
}) |> list_rbind()

i2 <- map(1:3, \(k) {
  s2k <- s2$s2[s2$k == k]
  i2_draws <- tau[, k]^2 / (tau[, k]^2 + s2k)
  h <- hdi95(i2_draws)
  tibble(
    comparison = comp_lab[as.character(k)],
    I2_median = median(i2_draws),
    I2_hdi_lo = h[1],
    I2_hdi_hi = h[2]
  )
}) |> list_rbind()

cat("RQ1: posterior median and 95% HDI; ROPE [-0.1, 0.1]; equivalent if >95% of posterior is inside ROPE\n")
print(rq1, n = Inf)
cat("\nHeterogeneity I² = τ² / (τ² + median(se_y²))\n")
print(i2, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
  node_split_one("mono vs total",           3, 1, list(c(3, 2, 1), c(2, 1, 1))),
  node_split_one("mono vs conceptual",      4, 1, list(c(4, 2, 1), c(2, 1, 1)))
)
```

```{r}
# RQ2–4: full-model slopes; need ≥8 studies per subgroup (Borenstein et al., 2009)
rq24_specs <- list(
  `1` = list(var = "age_c",                label = "age (per year, mean-centred)"),
  `2` = list(var = "vocab_type",           label = "measure (expressive − receptive)"),
  `3` = list(var = "infant_typical",       label = "typical development"),
  `4` = list(var = "assessment_procedure", label = "instrument (direct − indirect)"),
  `5` = list(var = "asjp_dist",            label = "ASJP distance")
)

n_sub <- imap(rq24_specs, \(sp, p) {
  d <- df_contrasts |> drop_na(all_of(full_raw))
  if (is.numeric(d[[sp$var]])) {
    tibble(covariate = sp$label, subgroup = "all", n_studies = n_distinct(d$short_cite))
  } else {
    d |>
      count(subgroup = as.character(.data[[sp$var]]), short_cite, name = "n") |>
      count(subgroup, name = "n_studies") |>
      mutate(covariate = sp$label, .before = 1)
  }
}) |> list_rbind() |>
  mutate(ok = n_studies >= 8)

cat("RQ2–4: studies per subgroup on the full-model complete-case sample (criterion: ≥8)\n")
print(n_sub, n = Inf)

beta_full <- as.matrix(fits$full$draws("beta", format = "draws_matrix"))
rq24 <- imap(rq24_specs, \(sp, p) {
  map(1:3, \(k) {
    summarise_draws(beta_full[, paste0("beta[", k, ",", p, "]")], rule = "out") |>
      mutate(covariate = sp$label, comparison = comp_lab[as.character(k)], .before = 1)
  }) |> list_rbind()
}) |> list_rbind()

cat("\nRQ2–4: full-model covariate slopes; ROPE [-0.1, 0.1]; significant if >95% of posterior is outside ROPE\n")
print(rq24, n = Inf)
```
